purpose: Freeze the reproducible calibration protocol that may eventually turn the TianTing relative combat baseline into reviewed object-field candidates. This contract records proven naked-stat anchors and a narrow legacy physical fixture, while explicitly blocking unproven global combat formulas and all runtime projection.

included: fixed-build declaration ledger and missing-evidence gate
D90 and canonical B10 log metrics
action-clock and design-space motion conversion interface
excluded: Y3 runtime, Lua, object-editor writes, map writes, UI, AI or network service
real combat logs, real engine readbacks, stable object IDs or template IDs
equipment, artifact, pet, collection, title or consumable numeric effects
experience, currency, materials, drops, pity, source profiles, receipts or settlement
chapter progress, encounter authority, party admission, cleanup or reconnect implementation

baseline_clock.offline_motion_plane: design-space only; it is not a Y3 coordinate or map scale

rounding_policy.damage_formula: formula-specific; the legacy physical fixture rounds once with floor at final damage
forbidden: using the legacy final-damage floor as a general stat-rounding rule

declaration.equipment_artifact_pet_collection_baseli: REF_EQUIP_NONE / no artifact active / no pet active / no external buff
declaration.initial_resources_and_cooldowns: all zero resources; cooldown ready; no temporary effects
declaration.input_priority_or_script: ultimate full -> momentum>=80 spender -> momentum>=40 spender -> combo -> generator -> normal attack

declaration.declared_output_budget: D90 is 88%-92% of C01 under equivalent logged conditions; legacy B10 <=92%; R90 is 70%-78%

declaration.initial_resources_and_cooldowns: all zero resources; cooldown ready; no temporary effects

fixed_build_declaration_ledger.completion_rule: All twelve profiles must be status=declared_and_replayed before a TianTing absolute projection may be proposed. A partially declared Lv60 profile is evidence only, never a substitute for the missing Lv41/Lv55 profiles.

metric_contract.eligible_damage_event: An event must be accepted final damage, have a finite non-negative final_damage value, lie in the fixture scope and target lifecycle, and have a non-negative integer tick. Healing, would_hit, rejected events, target-external damage, post-death events and private-session events are excluded unless a future fixture expressly adopts them.

B10.aggregation: max sum eligible final_damage; ties choose the smallest s
B10.legacy_alias: A legacy D10_peak is comparable only when it used the identical max-600-tick policy and event predicate. A named or manually selected 10-second window must declare its start tick and cannot silently claim B10 equivalence.

metric_contract.replay_determinism: A profile needs three independent records with equal fixture digest, equal input digest and byte-identical canonical event log before its output can be used as calibration evidence.

legacy_physical_static_target_v1.final_rounding: floor once after all multipliers and mitigation

formula_registry.formula_resolution_rule: Missing formula branches fail closed: a caller may record the missing evidence but cannot synthesize damage, hit, control duration, mitigation or an object-field candidate.

hit_and_control_boundary.legacy_static_fixture: Direct hits are confirmed at accepted begin_cast tick. Random hit/dodge/crit are disabled. This is a deterministic test rule, not a general hit formula.
hit_and_control_boundary.general_rule: Every damage or control event needs an accepted action identity, actor lifecycle, target lifecycle, scope, target-rank snapshot and formula revision. Unknown rank, missing hit formula, missing control-resistance formula or stale lifecycle produces no calibration result.
forbidden: using UI or client hit claims
borrowing a target rank from another actor
treating boss control conversion as a generic duration formula
inferring control resistance from a relative TianTing pressure coefficient

action_and_motion_interface.fixture_motion_rule: design_distance = move_speed_design_units_per_second * elapsed_ticks / 60. This is valid only inside a declared offline fixture plane.
forbidden: assuming zero windup outside the named legacy fixture

terrain_collision_fixture.rule: Candidate terrain diagrams and design-body coordinates are not collision evidence.

invariants: member count is captured before replay
left or stale members cannot rejoin the same fixture
cleanup observations never rewrite an already accepted final-damage log
the fixture observes existing authority semantics and does not implement or alter them

absolute_projection_gate.rule: Every required gate must be independently recorded as accepted in a later review. This offline contract cannot self-promote any gate.

acceptance.condition: package is offline-only with runtime_handoff=false and production_gate=closed
all four careers expose exact Lv41/Lv55/Lv60 formula-derived anchors
positive stat rounding uses floor(value + 0.5), never truncation
the fixed-build ledger covers exactly C01-C04 at Lv41/Lv55/Lv60 and preserves missing declarations
D90 and B10 use accepted final-damage event predicates and exact tick windows
legacy D10 comparison cannot silently claim canonical B10 equivalence
the legacy physical formula rejects magic, changed defense and enabled random inputs
general physical, magical, hit, crit, defense-penetration and control formulas remain null until adopted
the action/motion interface distinguishes design-space movement from engine fields
zero-windup legacy behavior cannot escape its named fixture
collision schema requires real whitebox observations and rejects diagram-only proof
party replay fixture accepts only one through four captured members and does not alter authority semantics
left, stale or cleanup events cannot rewrite accepted final-damage evidence
all absolute TianTing object fields and target IDs remain null and blocked
relative TianTing coefficients cannot be converted to absolute values before every gate is separately accepted
no currency, drop, pity, receipt, source-profile or reward field is created
no Y3 object, map, Lua, UI or runtime write is performed
reference tests prove calculations and fail-closed boundaries without claiming real combat evidence
